tasks.purpose: Record the path-dependent random-number issue and define the boundary for a possible future portable generator.
actions: NOTE ONLY: user has authorized documenting the issue, not changing the generator or rerunning an alternative experiment.

Historical generator line 379 seeds the background tape with stable_seed(str(args.model), args.seed, "quality-tape"). Identical model bytes at a new path can change generated scores. Preserve existing records and archived paths for historical replay.

If a future change is expressly approved, create a separately versioned generator using a documented stable model identity or content hash in the RNG key. Specify migration behavior, tests and output naming before running it. Never call its new outputs byte-identical historical results.

A future implementation should separate filesystem location from RNG identity, preserve per-read paired draws across shifts, and test path-invariance with identical bytes at two paths. Numerical comparison to historical results and separate publication labels would then be required.
validation: No source generator or quality data is changed by this handoff.
Any future portability test must use a tiny declared fixture before full-scale regeneration; historical exact-replay hash checks remain separate.

availability_notes: This is a known reproducibility constraint, not evidence that archived results are numerically invalid. Model path and model bytes are both part of the existing historical contract.
